info.title: Dev Gateway panel API
info.description: The API used by the panel UI and by local agents. Writes can be refused by read-only mode or the same-origin guard. Authentication, when enabled, is enforced by Traefik before a request reaches this application.
info.summary: Runtime inventory and bounded control for Dev Gateway.
